_about: Whether the public may not see a competition's draw now. Read by state.Competition.DrawHiddenIn (internal/state/draw_hidden_cases_test.go) and by drawHiddenFromPublic (web-mobile/js/__tests__/draw_visibility.test.jsx): the client twin and the server rule judge the same cases. A case with no drawHidden key is a competition stored before the field existed, which reads as published.

cases.name: a draft stored before the field existed reads as published
a tournament with no mode is officiated
a self-run tournament shows its draft
a competition in setup has no draw to hide
a started pools phase is public whatever is stored
a started knockout is public whatever is stored
a completed competition is public whatever is stored
